reason: Refuted as a new item. It costs nothing, but it adds ~0 information and it re-introduces a pattern the team has already refuted. (1) Duplicate: I-094 (a) already puts count(public >= 0.954) in the status line, and v_intel_rank-arithmetic-watch_value (25 Sep) already calls 'teams above X' the real watch metric, to be recomputed at the end. The only new parts are the model thresholds and the MC re-run. (2) The information value is ~0. N954 was 358 at 07:37Z and has grown at a steady 4.25-4.4/h for two days. With ~57 h to 29 Sep 17:00Z, N954 < 450 needs <= 1.6/h (0.38x the observed rate), while >= 520 needs only >= 2.8/h. The observable will almost surely confirm today's projection (520-690), so it will not change any action. (3) N954 does not identify what it claims to. In the r16fc-2 diagnostic, overfit (~520) gives P(X+ <= bronze) 0.32 and mid (~580) gives 0.00. That gap comes mostly from g/beta/rho/k, the share of public variants that beat X on private, which r16fc-2 itself calls unobservable before 30 Sep. It does not come from the 60-team difference in N954. Even in the most favourable field at 520, 'outside bronze' is 68%, which is at the stated 70% boundary. So the 450/520 thresholds are model artefacts. (4) Governance: 're-run the model with the realised growth' at the 29 Sep 17:57Z tick check makes MC output a finals input on the last day. That is the I-092 pattern, refuted again in round 15; R15-A1 (4) accepts qualitative reasons only. Calling it 'information only' does not change this, because its only use is to steer the tick. (5) Feasibility: the model scripts live in a session-only scratchpad and timer 18ff4796 is session-only (CONTEXT l.2362-2366). A re-run at 17:57Z against the 20:00Z tick deadline means re-implementing an unvalidated model under time pressure, and it invites a late re-tick with operational risk.
fix: Do not add thresholds or an MC re-run to the tick-check text. At the existing 28 Sep 17:57Z and 29 Sep 11:57Z/17:57Z checks, record N954/N955 and the team count as plain numbers in the I-094 status line, with no decision mapping. If the user wants to revisit #38 versus an upside second file (r16fc-4), give them the qualitative arithmetic well before 29 Sep: #38 pays only if the insertion is < 0 on private, eps > 0, and X+ is inside bronze. Let them decide early, not at 17:57Z on the last day. Add X's realised private rank to the 30 Sep private read (already proposed in r16fc-2) to calibrate the forecast post hoc.
